# The engine's `idempotency-inventory-v1` route set (U-159, P24 plan §2.0): inventory adjustments
# and counts, `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json. Client-declared until the WP-2
# pin bump. Append-only for this capability name: `keyable-inventory` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::InventoryV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-inventory-v1`.
DELETE /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/{id}
POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments
POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/{id}/void
POST /api/v1/inventory/counts
PUT /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/{id}
